Review [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the
[roadmap](../../docs/roadmap.md). Open an issue before implementing new features
not marked `Planned`.

Built-in authentication providers, RBAC engines, secret-manager SDKs, and UI
dashboards are outside the core repository's scope. Propose external integrations
through the `PLUG-001` extensibility interfaces; that roadmap item is currently
`Deferred`.

## Problem or Use Case

Who needs this, and what cannot they accomplish today?

## Proposed Change

Describe the smallest useful change and how it keeps the CLI and gateway lightweight.

## Roadmap Alignment

Reference the relevant roadmap ID and current status, or explain why a new item
is needed. For extensions, identify any interfaces needed under `PLUG-001`.

## Alternatives

Describe existing workarounds or external integrations considered.

## Acceptance Criteria

Describe observable outcomes that would make this request complete.
